name: Chinese Open Wordnet (Open Multilingual Wordnet)
license_verified_from: <Lexicon license="wordnet"> keyword in omw-cmn.xml (7/28/26) -- omw-data convention for the original Princeton WordNet license
attribution: Chinese Open Wordnet (COW) via Open Multilingual Wordnet. Wang and Bond (2013).
notes: No share-alike. Lexicon language attribute is 'cmn-Hans' (Simplified Mandarin) -- Traditional/Simplified is NOT unified by normalize_lemma's NFKC pass, so this wordnet's join rate against Traditional-script Kaikki lemmas is expected to be depressed; quantify in Stage 6 B3/B6 rather than assume. Distinct code-mapping concern (T5, zh<-cmn table-code aliasing for translations) already resolved in Breakdown 2 -- that fix does not extend to this wordnet's own script coverage.
